class: development-split organ ablation of the ORION control M, using the omission-ablation arms ME-F1 V1 froze and never ran, on the same eight development campaigns, against the same strongest parent on that split, through the frozen V1 runner; cannot alter ME-F1's CANNOT_CHECK terminal and authorizes no protected dispatch

lineage.v1_g0e_receipt: research/experiments/me-f1/ME_F1_G0E_OUTCOME_RECEIPT_V1.md (S5: SIMPLE_DIRECT 0.7562 > M 0.4062 > B5 0.3000; S5.1: B5 lost on its own control text)
lineage.b5_parity_receipt_pr276: research/experiments/me-f1/ME_F1_B5_PARITY_REPAIR_RECEIPT_V1.md (open PR #276; M's prompt untouched there and M held at 0.31-0.45; M switches tool after INCONCLUSIVE 0.30-0.44 of the time)
lineage.divergence_noted_not_resolved: the R2-frozen B5 text (f0ca74c2) and PR #276's measured B5 text (2b9d589c) differ and the frozen one has no model-arm measurement; this design does not run B5 and takes no position on which text is the comparator

negative_and_attribution.negative: at identical budget, toolbox, model and control-call count the bare SIMPLE_DIRECT beat M on the development split in every V1 run (0.7562/0.6625 vs 0.4062/0.4500; M INCONCLUSIVE rate 0.41-0.48 vs 0.054; M abstains 95 vs 39)

candidate_stages.(b) mandate: M's control text orders 'take the CHEAPEST action, escalate one level at a time, L0 more budget / L1 restart before L2 switch tool' -- which on this geometry sends the loop back to a dominated solver (R2 S3: local_search settles 0-12% at the critical ratios; exact_solve 100%)
candidate_stages.(a) discipline: the warrant gate scores abstention as zero on a world where nothing launders (G0e structural), so the discipline may pay coverage for a protection the world never needs
candidate_stages.(a') architectural residual: neither named organ carries the deficit

negative_and_attribution.why_ablation: V1 registered M_MINUS_WARRANT_GATE, M_MINUS_LOCUS_DIAGNOSIS and M_MINUS_MINIMUM_ESCALATION as omission ablations (design table 'omission ablations', mef1_arms.MODEL_ARMS) and wrote their texts before any outcome; running them discriminates (a) from (b) with zero new prompt text

constants.instrument_envelope_rule: V1's observed run-to-run range (SIMPLE 0.6625-0.7562, M 0.3125-0.4500 across four runs in V1 and PR #276) widened by one range width on each side
constants.primary_endpoint: warranted_correct_rate over ground-truth-decided rungs, F_CRITICAL campaigns only (V1 design S3.3; abstention scores zero)
constants.statistic: per (run, campaign) paired difference of the primary; one-sided sign-flip permutation p over the 16 paired observations
constants.channel: V1 frozen: mef1_channel.call_control -> codex-cli 0.129.0-alpha.15, gpt-5.5, medium, on billy-old; served id not exposed by the CLI (carried as UNPINNED_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION)
constants.geometry: V1 calibration receipt (WINDOW_HIT, L2, n_vars 30, 300000 checks, 7 actions + closing call), sha256 asserted at freeze/run/evaluate
constants.dev_seed: V1's development seed (the same 8 campaigns as every V1 run; 7 F_CRITICAL + 1 F_PLANTED, the planted one excluded from the primary by registration)

controls_consumed_by_the_gates.rule: 5 arms x 8 campaigns x 2 runs cells present, zero cannot_check
one distinct action count and one distinct call count across every cell
the two untouched arms' mean primary lies inside the widened V1 envelope
total claims > 0 so the unwarranted count is a measurement, not an empty denominator

gates.A0_CONTROLS_VALID: all controls PASS; a failure refuses every gate (exit 4)
gates.A1_MANDATE_IMPLICATED: mean(M_MINUS_MINIMUM_ESCALATION - M) > 0 with p <= 0.05 AND its INCONCLUSIVE rate is below M's (the mechanism the hypothesis names must move, not only the score)
gates.A4_reported: the best ablation against SIMPLE_DIRECT (both directions' p published; parity is reported, never gated as an absence claim)

routing.hypothesis: (a), regime-conditional: intermediate, not terminal -- the world forecloses the failure the organ prevents

pre_run_reachability_audit.seed_does_something: sign flips; the campaigns are V1's fixed development split by registration (the same instances every V1 run measured, so the instrument control is meaningful)
pre_run_reachability_audit.hard_gate_at_scale: 80 arm-campaign cells; the evaluator was exercised on synthetic tables covering every routing row
pre_run_reachability_audit.contrast_could_exist: per-campaign rates range over [0, 1]; A1 requires the INCONCLUSIVE rate to move as well (a score change without the named mechanism moving does not fire)
pre_run_reachability_audit.clause_narrowing: the runner evaluates exactly the gates above; the selftest asserts the twin's constants equal the script's
pre_run_reachability_audit.parent_isolation: none: identical budget, toolbox, model, call count and campaigns; every arm text is V1-frozen (mef1_arms.py sha256 asserted at freeze/run/evaluate); no arm text is authored by this design
pre_run_reachability_audit.served_model: not exposed by the CLI -- carried, not cleared
pre_run_reachability_audit.unsatisfiable_or_unfailable: the instrument control can fail (selftest plants an out-of-envelope parent and the verdict is refused); every routing row is reachable on synthetic input

pre_run_expectation_disclosed: PR #276 measured M switching tool after INCONCLUSIVE 0.30-0.44 of the time and holding at 0.31-0.45 while its prompt was untouched; the mandate hypothesis (b) predicts A1; the abstention gap (95 vs 39 UNRESOLVED) predicts A2 may also fire. Stated before dispatch so neither can be read afterwards as a surprise.
no_rescue_clause: no arm, constant, envelope, gate, seed or routing row changes after dispatch begins; a defect found afterwards is recorded in the receipt and repaired under a new identity
